collectible:1.text: Cigarette Cards are a collectible in Mafia: Definitive Edition. Cigarette cards are a series of 22 collectible cards put out by the Big Break tobacco company as a promotional item. Each card features hand-drawn portraits and informative bios for many of the key players in the criminal underbellies of Lost Heaven, Empire Bay, and New Bordeaux. There are 22 Cigarette Cards to collect.
